title: Demo kit scenarios
description: The scenario catalog the demo kit reads (src/demo/kit/scenarios.json): each scenario of the demo with its personas, use cases, screens, end-to-end spec and the preconditions "demo check" proves before a demo. A precondition is a read the kit makes as a persona (a list with a count of matching items, or one value), or a persona's pending count. Every name is fictional.

personaCount.description: How many personas the demo has (src/adapters/azure/seed/demo-personas.json).

runs.description: The runs and role tracks demo play can play (demo play run-15, demo play pmo): each names its steps in order, and the steps to play off-screen before it (before).

id.description: The scenario ID, S-01 and on. Step IDs of the presenter scripts and the end-to-end test titles start with it.

story.description: The time slot of the guided story (src/docs/demo/run-15-minutes.md), such as 5:00-7:00, or null for a scenario outside it.

spec.description: The end-to-end spec file in src/tests/e2e that plays it, or null until the suite has one.

script.description: The presenter script in src/docs/demo, or null until the documentation has one.

section.description: The story section the scenario belongs to (W1 to W12 in src/docs/demo/scenarios.md), or null.

reset.description: How to get the scenario ready again after it was played.

label.description: What must hold, in plain words. The check prints it when it does not.

as.description: The persona the read is made as.

tool.description: The read tool, called on POST /api/{tool}.

input.description: The tool's input. A value {"$lookup": {"tool", "input", "list", "where", "pick"}} is the field pick of the first item of that read that meets where, such as a portfolio's ID by its name.

list.description: The dot path of the list in the answer (default data.items). Paged lists are read to the end unless page is false.

page.description: False: read one answer only, for a list that is not paged.

value.description: The dot path of one value in the answer, such as data.ownerGaps, instead of a list: it meets expect, or, for an object such as data.counts, where.

needs.description: ai-client: the precondition reads work the director made as Claude Code, so it is checked only when the director could (a local server, or a demo install with the operator's Claude Code token), and skipped otherwise.

pending.description: A persona whose pending count is checked, instead of a read.

where.description: Dot paths of an item, each with the matcher its value must meet.

matcher.description: A plain value is equality (text ignores case). An object names one or more tests: equals, contains (text), in, min, max, exists, some and none (an array with an element that meets, or none that meets, a nested where), length (an array's length meets a nested matcher).
